The best pair on garnet is QB12 and QB11. I read the default quality metric set for garnet. Its highest IRB CZ fidelity is metrics.irb.cz.slepian_crf.QB12__QB11.fidelity, which is 0.99869 with an uncertainty of about 0.00035. The next best pair is QB12 and QB7 at 0.99802.

I ran one Bell circuit on garnet:mock with 100 shots. Job 01a15fa3-9a50-73f4-87ea-02f461e53e0f completed. The counts were 00: 27, 01: 27, 10: 19, 11: 27.

The circuit used native gates on the physical qubits QB12 (control) and QB11 (target): prx, then cz, then prx. One measure instruction measured both qubits under the key "m". I named the qubits directly in the circuit, so no transpiler could move them.

I first tried the Qiskit transpile route with initial_layout=[11, 10]. A check in my script found that the transpiled circuit would measure QB19 and QB20 instead. The script stopped before submitting, so that attempt sent no job.

garnet:mock is a simulator that returns random results. The counts are spread evenly for that reason and do not show Bell correlations.

Scripts are in /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-94/: cal.py, bell_native.py, fetch.py, and the unused bell.py and dbg.py.
